with T = the pointer table at qword `rcx+0x10` and set/clear meaning bit 0 of dword `+8` of a T entry: when bit 0 of byte `r8+0x57` is set, calls `002DC290(rdx, ...)` with a stack record built from qword `rcx+8`; calls `00393190(rcx, 1)`, clears T`[+0xD8]` and T`[+0xB0]`, sets the 7 entries indexed by the bytes at `00D23EAC`, clears T`[+0xD0]`, and sets T`[+0xD8]` when bit 2 of byte `r8+0x57` is set; when bit 0 is set it fills T`[+0xB8]`, T`[+0xC8]` and T`[+0xC0]` (`00377B60`, `0029FE20`, `003778B0`, `0029FB50`) and takes id = dword `r8+0x80` (`r8+0x4C` when 0), else clears those three and takes id = dword `r8+0x4C`; stores `003778B0(id)` at qword `+0x18` of T`[+0x90]`, or `002F9860` of `0x7EC`, `0x7EB`, `0x7EE` or `0x7ED` when `00264150()` is non-zero and `00264F90(id)` is 7, `0x16`, `0x19` or `0x1D`; clears T`[+0xA0]`, stores `00377B60(id)` at qword `+0x18` of T`[+0x98]`; and calls `00393160(rcx, 8, 3, 3, a)`, clears T`[+0x38]`, then `00393160(rcx, 11, 2, 1, b)` and `00393160(rcx, 13, 2, 1, c)`, where a, b, c are 0 when a `002F9860` value was stored, else word `r8+0x18` and bytes `r8+0x1A`, `r8+0x1B` capped at 999, 59, 59 (b and c are 59 when the word is 1000 or more)

notes: Doubts. 0057FB00 (887 B) is summarised: the row omits the dword +0x20 stores of 0020E620(0) beside each qword +0x18 store, and the exact word arithmetic in the bit-0 path (T[+0xC8] word +0xC = word +0xC of T[+0xB8] minus its own word +0x10; T[+0xC0] words +0xC/+0xE from the same pair, then +0xC overwritten by word +4 of qword [T[+0xC0]] minus the 0029FE20 out-value at rsp+0x38). In the bit-0 path 00377B60 and 003778B0 are called with dword r8+0x4C, not with id. The caps: word r8+0x18 >= 1000 gives a=999 and b=c=59 regardless of the bytes; otherwise each byte >= 60 becomes 59. The 002DC290 record is dword 0x20002, word (w8-4), word (wA-4), and the third argument points at four dwords 0x4816224A (not decoded by the listing). 002BA240: whether 005C5230's result survives in eax depends on 00808C40 (the cookie check), so the row does not claim a return value on the default path; the dword at record +0x04 is never written. 00402BF0: 0x3F800000 is left raw because the listing does not decode it. 0028E660: rcx is never written, so 002B9D30 gets the caller's rcx; 002BA020/002BA000/002BA040 get whatever registers survive.
